files.description: The complete EHI export documentation page. Single static HTML page containing all documentation: file naming conventions, export format description (PDFs and images), file linking explanation, usage terms, and contact information. This is the entirety of the vendor's EHI export documentation — no downloadable files or data dictionary exists.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://ehnote.com/certification/ehi-export' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o ehi-export-page.html
